label: Mid-prefix input of q/a/e/w/o/c (original positions 2-5)
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase. It is essentially silent at t=0, on <DEL>, and in the copy phase (16 activations in total). Activity peaks at positions 2-5 (t=3 has the highest rate, 22%) and it almost never fires after position 6. It is token-selective: the input tokens q, a, e, w, o and c have 3-4.6x lift, followed by 0, d and m. It fires mostly on the first occurrence of a token (94% of mass). The strongest activations come on q/e/w/o early in sequences whose preceding tokens are h, r, 2 or l (these have about 2x lift as prev/prev2/first token). Repeated earlier q/a/e/w/o/c inputs seem to weaken it (seen from examples, not quantified). The predicate covers 90% of top-quartile activations but only 43% of the lowest quartile, which is a weak tail on other tokens (d, m, u, 0, y). The tail plus false positives at later positions limit F1 to about 0.62.
